description: Agent Real Estate: submit a closing statement with the purchase agreement: the agreement with its price, currency, earnest money, closing day, each seller credit with its name and amount, and the costs it assigns to the seller and to the buyer; the statement with whose it is (buyer or seller), its closing day, sale price, currency, loan amount, earnest money credited, each credit with its id, name, amount and the party it goes to, each fee with its id, name, amount, payer and whether it names one charge, each proration with its id, item, annual amount, the days it covers from and to, its day basis (360, 365 or 366), its amount and the party it credits, and the totals due from the buyer and due to the seller. The signed report gives the agreement, the statement, the sale price against the agreed one, the agreed credits missing or short and the credits the agreement does not grant, the fees by payer with those charged to the wrong party and those not itemized, every proration recomputed from its annual amount, days and basis, and each total recomputed against the stated one, and counts them, and names a discrepant statement: a sale price unlike the agreement, an agreed credit missing or short, a fee charged to the party the agreement does not assign, a proration that does not recompute within one currency unit, totals that do not add up and earnest money left uncredited; then a credit the agreement does not grant, a lump-sum fee with no itemization and a closing day unlike the agreed one, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No price on either side, no totals, no agreed credits, fees with no cost allocation in the agreement, no prorations, or a proration with no annual amount or dates leaves the statement unverified. This reads a closing statement’s figures against the agreement and holds nothing: wever_agent-escrow-lite holds USDC for agreed agent work and releases or returns it, wever_escrow-brief reads an escrow agreement excerpt into its parties, amount and release terms, and wever_escrow-quote gives escrow terms and fees before anyone commits, while the closing check reads the property settlement’s price, credits, fees, prorations and totals; wever_tokenized-settlement-check reads a tokenized share’s delivery and payment legs. Verdict realty_closing_discrepant, realty_closing_partial, realty_closing_unverified or realty_closing_balanced. POST /api/realty-closing-check. Reads the property records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment, appraisal, listing, brokerage or external write. Agent Real Estate reads supplied property records after the fact and checks them against themselves and against the summary or approval given to the principal: a listing, the title and ownership record, a valuation, the seller disclosure, a lease, an offer or purchase agreement, an inspection report and a closing statement. Beside it, the Tokenized Asset Purchase checks such as wever_tokenized-quote-check read purchases of tokenized asset shares, while a realty check reads conventional property records; the Agent Insurance checks such as wever_insurance-coverage-check read policies and coverage, which a realty check never reads; and the payment escrow tools such as wever_agent-escrow-lite hold and release funds, while a realty check holds nothing. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-real-estate-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-real-estate/.
